workflows.title: Enter the correct leadership workspace
workflows.trigger: Principal signs in or holds more than one role.
workflows.actors: Principal; Access service
workflows.preconditions: Active account, leadership assignment and at least one explicit branch grant; required foundations released.

steps.result: Existing trust and authentication policy applies.

steps.action: Resolve permitted roles and branches from the current account.
steps.result: Leadership appears only with a grant; no student/finance access inferred.

steps.action: Choose Leadership and a permitted branch.
steps.result: Header shows institution, branch, role and school-local date.

steps.action: Load only enabled and authorized navigation.
steps.result: A complete attendance-only experience is possible.

fields.name: Branch
fields.rule: Only currently granted branches; never inferred from institution ownership.

workflows.outcome: Correct branch-scoped leadership home.
exceptions: No leadership grant: show permitted workspace choices, not a broken dashboard.
Session expiry: clear protected content and return through sign-in.
workflows.authorization: Principal role is not a wildcard. Protected reads and mutations reauthorize independently.
workflows.reads: UserAccount; active role/grant; organization/school state; released/entitled/branch-enabled modules.
workflows.writes: Existing session/context selection only; no role creation.
workflows.acceptance: Unrelated branch, school-slug forgery and revoked role cannot open the workspace.

workflows.title: Switch branches without losing context
workflows.trigger: Leader oversees multiple explicitly granted branches.
workflows.actors: Principal or institution leader
workflows.preconditions: Destination branch grant exists; any pending command has been reconciled.

steps.result: Each allowed option names institution and branch.

steps.action: Check unsaved work or unresolved commands.
steps.result: Save/discard prompt for editable draft; unresolved decision must be checked first.
Server re-resolves module and object permissions.

steps.action: Clear prior branch filters and data.
steps.result: New branch context reloads; a deep link from the previous branch is not silently reused.

fields.name: Destination
fields.rule: A returned branch reference, not an arbitrary UUID.

fields.name: Unfinished work
fields.rule: Remain, save draft if supported, or discard explicitly.

workflows.outcome: New branch view with consistent scope and capabilities.
exceptions: Destination grant revoked while chooser is open: remain in old authorized context.
Different timezone: date is recalculated in destination school timezone.
workflows.authorization: Cross-branch aggregate authority is separate from branch switching.
workflows.reads: Current branch grants; module availability; pending command references.
workflows.writes: Existing context-selection/session state only.
workflows.acceptance: A stale selection is rejected; no old branch record flashes or leaks.

workflows.title: Work under a temporary leadership delegation
workflows.trigger: Approved acting principal or deputy covers a defined period.
workflows.actors: Delegator; acting leader; Access owner
workflows.preconditions: School-approved delegation policy, eligible delegate and bounded grant management authority.

steps.action: Choose eligible colleague, branch, allowed actions and effective window.
steps.result: Preview excludes authorities the delegator cannot delegate.
Access owner records a dated delegation.
Visible Acting role, scope and expiry; no misleading permanent title.

steps.action: Recheck expiry on every protected action.
steps.result: Expired or revoked authority stops new decisions.

fields.name: Window
fields.rule: Starts before ends; maximum determined by approved policy.

workflows.outcome: Time-limited delegated authority with clear accountability.
exceptions: Self-delegation or privilege expansion: deny.
Pending work outlives delegation: route to currently authorized owner.
workflows.authorization: Grant issuance and delegated operation are different capabilities; originator identity remains visible.
workflows.reads: Access grant/delegation rules; active staff assignment.
workflows.writes: Delegation through Access owner, safe audit, approved recipient notification if enabled.
workflows.acceptance: Delegate cannot approve outside scope or after expiry; existing receipts remain attributable.

workflows.title: Handle access changes during a leadership action
workflows.trigger: Role, branch permission or module availability changes while a page is open.
workflows.actors: Leader; Access and source owner
workflows.preconditions: All protected operations and receipt lookups use current server authorization.

steps.action: Open an item from the current screen.
steps.result: The owner checks live scope before returning its contents.
Sensitive content is removed; generic unavailable state is shown.

steps.action: Use school support or another permitted context.
steps.result: No client-side override is offered.

steps.action: Reauthorize any saved status reference later.
steps.result: Receipt identity is not itself access permission.

fields.name: Recovery destination
fields.rule: Only a currently permitted context or school contact.

workflows.outcome: No unauthorized read or write following permission loss.
exceptions: Outcome of a previous command is unknown: keep a non-sensitive reference, not the hidden item details.
Disabled module does not erase owner records or obligations.
workflows.authorization: Apply to reads, downloads, exports, retries and exact replay, not only navigation.
workflows.reads: Current grants/module policy; owner command status under access policy.
workflows.writes: Only safe audit of denial; no protected record mutation.
workflows.acceptance: A command checked after revocation is denied; denied page does not disclose private details.

workflows.title: Review my school today
workflows.trigger: Start of day or return to the workspace.
workflows.actors: Principal
workflows.preconditions: Branch-scoped source projections are authorized; school date/time and data freshness known.

steps.action: Show branch, school-local date and last successful refresh.
steps.result: No ambiguous institution-wide totals.
Registers due, uncovered sessions and assigned decisions appear only when those modules exist.
Filters, cutoff, source records and permitted action carry through.
Resolved items update without pretending every related follow-up is closed.

fields.name: Date
fields.rule: Defaults to school today; historical dates explicit.

fields.name: Priority
fields.rule: Operational deadline/severity rule, never a pupil or teacher risk score.

workflows.outcome: One clear next action grounded in evidence.
exceptions: No items: show No action required for this scope, plus data cutoff.
Missing module: omit its widget; do not show zero or an upsell.
workflows.authorization: Home projection inherits each source capability; aggregated cards do not create drill-down authority.
workflows.reads: Authorized session/decision/follow-up projections and as-of metadata.
workflows.writes: None.
workflows.acceptance: Every number has a definition and opens the same scoped record set.

workflows.title: Recognize stale, incomplete or unavailable information
workflows.trigger: An owner service cannot refresh or some records are not yet submitted.
workflows.actors: Principal; source projection
workflows.preconditions: Freshness and completeness are available as separate metadata.

steps.action: Label source cutoff and current refresh outcome.
steps.result: Last known data is visibly stale; unavailable is not zero.
Show source/type/count only within authority.

steps.action: Retry or open a safe source view.
steps.result: Retry uses current scope; input/filter state is retained.
New cutoff/version is visible; pending decisions need fresh evidence.

fields.name: Completeness
fields.rule: Due/received/unknown counts, never a vague confidence score.

workflows.outcome: Leader can judge whether information supports a decision.
exceptions: Partial source failure: show available sections with explicit gaps.
Stale evidence for mutation: block and re-review before decision.
workflows.authorization: Do not expose withheld cases through error counts or hidden-widget totals.
workflows.reads: Owner projection watermark; source availability; exact metric definition.
workflows.writes: None apart from bounded refresh telemetry.
workflows.acceptance: Unavailable source does not appear as 0; approval cannot consume stale expected version.

workflows.title: Run the weekly leadership review
workflows.trigger: Scheduled school review meeting.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized coordinators
workflows.preconditions: Approved meeting purpose and source access; follow-up coordination enabled for actions.

steps.result: Brief shows coverage, outstanding actions and relevant published changes.

steps.action: Inspect a concern and agree an action.
steps.result: Owner, due time, source reference and completion evidence are explicit.
Each action is routed to its owning team; recipients are previewed.
Reassignment and verified outcomes remain traceable.

fields.name: Due time
fields.rule: School-local input converted to an instant.

fields.name: Completion evidence
fields.rule: Source-state condition or permitted attachment reference.

workflows.outcome: Actionable review brief and owned follow-ups.
exceptions: No reliable comparison period: omit trend claim.
Action falls outside participants’ authority: hand off instead of exposing private records.
workflows.authorization: A meeting participant does not gain the principal’s source privileges.
workflows.reads: Approved report snapshots and follow-up history.
workflows.writes: Internal follow-up records and approved meeting action references only.
workflows.acceptance: Next review distinguishes open, overdue, evidence-ready and verified closed actions.

workflows.title: Inspect register submission coverage
workflows.trigger: Principal wants to know whether expected registers have been received.
workflows.actors: Principal; Attendance owner
workflows.preconditions: Existing exact-session attendance contract and leadership read capability.

steps.action: Open Attendance oversight for a date/cutoff.
steps.result: Show scheduled, due by cutoff, received and awaiting counts.
Rows are exact eligible sessions, not absent pupils.
Show scheduled teacher, class, time, current status and last update.
A now-submitted session is no longer presented as missing.

fields.name: Date/cutoff
fields.rule: School-local date with explicit server as-of.

fields.name: Filters
fields.rule: Class, session status and responsible teacher within permitted branch; no default selections.

fields.name: Sort
fields.rule: Due time or class; stable ID tie-breaker.

workflows.outcome: Exact list of due but unsubmitted registers.
exceptions: No registers due: show No registers due yet, not 100%.
Cancelled or future-not-due session: excluded from due denominator with explicit reason.
workflows.authorization: Read-only principal oversight does not grant attendance.mark or attendance.correct.
workflows.reads: Session schedule/state; frozen roster only if detailed grant; authoritative submission/revision receipt.
workflows.writes: None.
workflows.acceptance: Received + awaiting = due for the same cutoff; each register counted once.

workflows.title: Create an accountable missing-register follow-up
workflows.trigger: A due session is still awaiting submission.
workflows.actors: Principal; operational coordinator; responsible teacher
workflows.preconditions: Fresh missing-session evidence, internal follow-up capability and eligible assignee.

steps.action: Open missing session and choose Follow up.
steps.result: Preview teacher, class, due state and any existing active follow-up.

steps.action: Choose coordinator, due time and brief note.
steps.result: Assignee must be eligible; this does not reassign teaching authority.
System rechecks source; inserts one follow-up or returns an existing one.

steps.action: Return reference and assignment/delivery state separately.
steps.result: Assigned does not mean the recipient read a message.
Only an eligible teacher submits attendance through the Attendance owner.

fields.name: Assignee
fields.rule: Eligible staff in same permitted school; no general account lookup.

fields.name: Due time
fields.rule: Explicit time, timezone and school working policy.

fields.name: Note
fields.rule: Max proposed 500 characters; no pupil/health detail.

workflows.outcome: One scoped, assigned follow-up with due time and evidence rule.
exceptions: Teacher submitted before confirmation: do not create obsolete work; show current receipt.
Existing open follow-up: open it or explicitly request authorized reassignment.
Network uncertainty: check same intent before retry.
workflows.authorization: Assigning a follow-up grants no attendance marking, correction or new student data access.
workflows.reads: Session status/version; active staff eligibility; existing open follow-up.
workflows.writes: Coordination follow-up, intent receipt and minimal audit; optional approved delivery event.
workflows.acceptance: Duplicate click makes one follow-up; session submission remains untouched.

workflows.title: Follow up multiple missing registers safely
workflows.trigger: Several due sessions need action.
workflows.actors: Principal; Coordination owner
workflows.preconditions: All selected rows reauthorized; bulk capability explicitly enabled; single-item workflow proven.

steps.result: Selection count and scope remain visible across filters.
Identify already resolved, duplicate, ineligible and eligible rows.

steps.action: Confirm recipients, common due time and per-item effects.
steps.result: No hidden select-all across unreviewed pages.
Per-session succeeded/skipped/failed results and references returned.
Uncertain items use status lookup; successful items are not resent.

fields.name: Selection
fields.rule: Explicit bounded ID list; proposed max 25.

fields.name: Assignee rule
fields.rule: Per-session validated coordinator or approved routing.

workflows.outcome: Honest per-item outcomes with no duplicate follow-ups.
exceptions: Permission/source changes after preview: that item is denied/skipped without rollback of unrelated successes.
Filter change does not silently change confirmed payload.
workflows.authorization: Bulk authority cannot exceed single-item authority. No bulk attendance marking/correction.
workflows.reads: Same records as single follow-up plus versioned preview.
workflows.writes: One coordination command receipt per session, plus non-sensitive batch summary.
workflows.acceptance: 3 selected with 1 resolved and 1 denied yields 1 new, 1 skipped, 1 denied; no false batch-success label.

workflows.title: Verify, close or reopen a follow-up
workflows.trigger: Assignee reports completion or underlying session changes.
workflows.actors: Assignee; principal/verifier; Coordination and Attendance owners
workflows.preconditions: Current follow-up scope; explicit close/reopen capability; fresh evidence read.

steps.action: Mark Evidence ready with a permitted source reference.
steps.result: This is a completion claim, not closure.
Re-read the exact Attendance receipt and follow-up version.

steps.action: Confirm closure only if evidence rule is satisfied.
steps.result: System records verifier, source version and closed time.

steps.action: Reopen with a reason if later authorized evidence invalidates closure.
steps.result: History remains; active assignee/due time chosen again.

fields.name: Evidence
fields.rule: Exact source receipt/revision or approved evidence type.

fields.name: Reopen reason
fields.rule: Required; does not edit prior closure event.

workflows.outcome: Verified closure or explicit continued work.
exceptions: Source still missing: cannot verify closure merely from assignee text.
Stale follow-up version: show new owner/status before deciding.
Source inaccessible: block verification and route to authorized verifier.
workflows.authorization: No closure from a broad role alone; no privilege escalation through evidence links.
workflows.reads: Follow-up lifecycle/version; fresh owner evidence and current access.
workflows.writes: Versioned closure/reopen event and audit; no Attendance mutation.
workflows.acceptance: Teacher submission changes source to received; follow-up closes only under documented verification rule.

workflows.title: Review factual pupil attendance patterns
workflows.trigger: School policy calls for a review of recorded absence patterns.
workflows.actors: Principal or attendance lead; authorized student support coordinator
workflows.preconditions: Explicit pupil-level attendance purpose; defined date window and outcome rules.

steps.action: Choose recorded period and approved review criterion.
steps.result: Show source coverage before any pattern list.

steps.action: Group factual submitted outcomes by permitted pupil.
steps.result: Count sessions/dates explicitly; no speculative risk label.
Separate late, absent, excused and unsubmitted sessions.

steps.action: Route a support follow-up if warranted.
steps.result: Guardian contact/relationship and care information require their own grants.

fields.name: Criterion
fields.rule: Approved rule with version; no secret default scoring.

fields.name: Follow-up purpose
fields.rule: Attendance support; no inferred medical/family reason.

workflows.outcome: Evidence-based human review and authorized next action.
exceptions: Incomplete registers: disclose missing coverage; do not manufacture absence.
Restriction on pupil detail: show authorized aggregate or deny; do not expose identity in export.
workflows.authorization: Attendance purpose is not health, safeguarding or unrestricted family access.
workflows.reads: Submitted session outcomes; frozen roster; scoped student summary; rule version.
workflows.writes: Only an approved coordination/support request if confirmed.
workflows.acceptance: Same pupil with multiple absent sessions is counted as one pupil only when metric explicitly says unique pupils.

workflows.title: Review an absence explanation
workflows.trigger: Guardian submits an explanation requiring school disposition.
workflows.actors: Principal only if delegated; attendance office; guardian
workflows.preconditions: Verified guardian-origin request and an explicit school-review capability.

steps.result: See exact child/session/date and minimum explanation permitted for purpose.

steps.action: Check related attendance and prior disposition.
steps.result: Explanation status is separate from attendance outcome.

steps.action: Record allowed disposition or ask for clarification.
steps.result: Response communicates school review, not an automatic correction.

steps.action: If required, perform separate correction workflow.
steps.result: Correction receipt is linked without impersonating teacher or guardian.

fields.name: Clarification
fields.rule: Bounded question; recipient is current authorized originator.

workflows.outcome: Explained school decision with traceable handoff.
exceptions: Restricted relationship changes: recheck before reply.
Principal not delegated: view only permitted routing state, not explanation body.
workflows.authorization: Principal status alone does not grant family/care detail or correction authority.
workflows.reads: Owned family request; current guardian purpose; exact attendance record/version.
workflows.writes: Request disposition and permitted message; correction is separate.
workflows.acceptance: Approving an explanation does not mutate an attendance mark.

workflows.title: Review an attendance correction request
workflows.trigger: Teacher, student or parent flags a potential record error.
workflows.actors: Delegated attendance reviewer; principal as coordinator
workflows.preconditions: Correction capability separately granted to actual decision maker; source version available.

steps.action: Inspect minimal request and route to authorized reviewer.
steps.result: No edit action appears without correction grant.

steps.action: Compare original mark and allowed evidence.
steps.result: Source revision, reason and current conflict checks are visible.

steps.action: Review and confirm correction through Attendance owner.
steps.result: Expected-version command appends correction evidence.
History retains original and corrected outcome; notifications follow owner policy.

fields.name: New outcome
fields.rule: Attendance policy allowlist; no bulk default.

fields.name: Reason
fields.rule: Required bounded reason, evidence reference if policy requires.

workflows.outcome: Authorized corrected revision or reasoned rejection.
exceptions: Submitted record changed during review: re-read before correction.
Insufficient evidence: request clarification or reject, preserving history.
workflows.authorization: Coordination does not confer correction permission; no principal mark-all shortcut.
workflows.reads: Current attendance revision; request; authorized evidence.
workflows.writes: Owner correction command plus audit/receipt, if explicitly permitted.
workflows.acceptance: Concurrent correction does not overwrite a newer revision.

workflows.title: Resolve an incorrect or duplicate scheduled session
workflows.trigger: Coverage appears wrong because the underlying session setup is wrong.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academic/Attendance administrator
workflows.preconditions: Source session read grant; administrative lifecycle command owned elsewhere.

steps.action: Open suspected session and related evidence.
steps.result: See timing, offering and current roster/submission state.

steps.action: Send setup review to the authorized administrator.
steps.result: Do not delete the row from a leadership dashboard.

steps.action: Apply allowed correction/cancellation under owner rules.
steps.result: Submitted sessions and referenced evidence receive extra protection.
Historical totals disclose the applicable as-of policy.

fields.name: Concern
fields.rule: Wrong time, offering, duplication or other bounded reason.

workflows.outcome: Correct source setup or an explained rejection.
exceptions: Already submitted: cannot casually cancel/delete to improve coverage.
Related reports changed: surface revision rather than silently alter prior exported snapshot.
workflows.authorization: Principal can inspect/route only within separate capabilities.
workflows.reads: Session/offering/schedule revisions and receipts.
workflows.writes: Request only from leadership; source change through owning administrator.
workflows.acceptance: Removing a dashboard exception cannot erase a submitted attendance record.

workflows.title: Review timetable conflicts and uncovered classes
workflows.trigger: A class is uncovered or a published schedule changes.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academics + Learning + Assessments owner
workflows.preconditions: Published recurring timetable and coverage owner; manual attendance sessions alone are insufficient.

steps.result: List published uncovered/conflicting occurrences with evidence.
Show current assignment and impact without private staff absence reasons.

steps.action: Route to timetable coordinator or open delegated cover action.
steps.result: Eligible staff and conflict checks come from the owner.
Publication/version refreshes; related attendance remains separate.

workflows.outcome: Resolved cover arrangement or a traceable coordination request.
exceptions: Concurrent timetable edit requires refreshed review.
No eligible cover: show unresolved status and escalation, not an invented allocation.
workflows.authorization: No general timetable-edit or attendance-mark authority from a principal role.
workflows.reads: Published occurrences; dated teacher eligibility and assignment; conflict projection.
workflows.writes: Owner-specific cover request/decision only.
workflows.acceptance: Assigned substitute cannot clash with another occurrence; cancelled sessions remain traceable.

workflows.title: Review assignment completion with the right denominator
workflows.trigger: Leader reviews work completion for a class or subject.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academics + Learning + Assessments owner
workflows.preconditions: Learning oversight grant and published assignment audience/extension rules.

steps.result: Show expected learner-assignment pairs due by cutoff.

steps.action: Open submitted, awaiting or excused group.
steps.result: Latest accepted attempt per pair counts once; private drafts remain private.
Extensions and missing audience data are explicit.

steps.action: Create a scoped teaching follow-up if justified.
steps.result: Action names class/task, owner and evidence goal; no bulk student penalty.

fields.name: Population
fields.rule: Published assignment audience as of documented snapshot.

workflows.outcome: Accurate completion review and an authorized educational next step.
exceptions: Unavailable submission data is not non-completion.
A second attempt does not count as a second pupil.
workflows.authorization: Default leadership oversight does not expose private drafts or all student response content.
workflows.reads: Published assignment recipients; accepted attempts; extensions/excused policy.
workflows.writes: Optional internal coordination action.
workflows.acceptance: Extended/not-yet-due and excused pairs follow the documented denominator policy.

workflows.title: Review feedback awaiting return
workflows.trigger: Accepted learner work has not received returned feedback within school policy.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academics + Learning + Assessments owner
workflows.preconditions: Learning oversight and an approved turnaround definition; teacher draft privacy preserved.

steps.result: Show accepted attempts awaiting student-facing feedback.

steps.action: Inspect elapsed time and source policy.
steps.result: Calendar/working-day basis and cutoff are visible.
No private draft comments or automatic staff performance verdict.
Fresh evidence supports follow-up verification.

fields.name: Turnaround rule
fields.rule: Versioned school policy; no hidden hardcoded deadline.

workflows.outcome: Clear feedback backlog with owned follow-up.
exceptions: Returned then withdrawn feedback is shown under owner policy, not counted as permanently delivered.
Incomplete timestamps block unsupported average.
workflows.authorization: Feedback oversight is separate from permission to read full learner work.
workflows.reads: Accepted attempt timestamp; returned feedback publication timestamps/state.
workflows.writes: Optional coordination record; no teacher feedback edits.
workflows.acceptance: Teacher Save private draft does not clear Awaiting return.

workflows.title: Coordinate an evidence-based learning concern
workflows.trigger: A teacher or authorized academic review identifies a learning concern.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academics + Learning + Assessments owner
workflows.preconditions: Approved learning-support purpose; school process and authorized coordinator.

steps.result: Describe observable facts, not a diagnosis or predictive score.
Owner, review date and intended improvement are explicit.

steps.action: Include family/student only through authorized channels.
steps.result: Relationship and communication purposes rechecked.
Close or revise the support action; private specialist records remain separate.

workflows.outcome: Human-owned learning support with a review checkpoint.
exceptions: Sensitive care concern routes to the specialist workspace.
No access to evidence: assign authorized reviewer without exposing it.
workflows.authorization: No automatic mental-health inference, grading change or disciplinary action.
workflows.reads: Authorized learning evidence and minimal student/class context.
workflows.writes: Restricted educational follow-up only; separate specialist referral if needed.
workflows.acceptance: General school dashboards never reveal confidential support narrative.

workflows.title: Check assessment and report readiness
workflows.trigger: School approaches a report publication milestone.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academics + Learning + Assessments owner
workflows.preconditions: Assessment readiness projection and explicit branch oversight grant.

steps.result: Show configured requirements and source cutoff.

steps.action: Inspect missing marks, unresolved outcomes or pending moderation.
steps.result: Different readiness blockers remain distinct.

steps.action: Assign coordination to the responsible owner.
steps.result: No fabricated marks or implicit publication rights.
Ready means prerequisites satisfied, not Published.

workflows.outcome: An explainable readiness checklist and remaining blockers.
exceptions: Absent, Exempt and Not entered cannot collapse into numeric zero.
Revised scheme invalidates stale readiness snapshot.
workflows.authorization: Leadership read does not imply mark entry, moderation approval or publication.
workflows.reads: Assessment scheme; outcome completeness; moderation state; publication prerequisites.
workflows.writes: Coordination actions only unless separately delegated.
workflows.acceptance: 100% readiness cannot be displayed while a mandatory outcome is unresolved.

workflows.title: Perform an explicitly delegated moderation decision
workflows.trigger: Assessment owner assigns a moderation item to the principal.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academics + Learning + Assessments owner
workflows.preconditions: Distinct moderation grant; conflict-of-interest rule and current evidence version.

steps.result: View only permitted mark/rubric evidence and recorded checks.

steps.action: Declare conflict or request missing information.
steps.result: No self-approval of own prohibited work.
Reason and impact preview use the owner contract.
Versioned decision receipt; result publication remains separate.

fields.name: Reason
fields.rule: Required where policy mandates; returned items need actionable explanation.

workflows.outcome: One attributable moderation decision.
exceptions: Changed marks or assignment after preview: conflict, re-review.
Unknown response: status check before a new intent.
workflows.authorization: Moderation and result publication are separate grants.
workflows.reads: Assigned assessment decision and permitted evidence.
workflows.writes: Assessment-owned moderation command, receipt and audit.
workflows.acceptance: Decision inbox cannot bypass the assessment owner’s guards.

workflows.title: Authorize or hand off report publication
workflows.trigger: Reports are approved and ready for release.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Academics + Learning + Assessments owner
workflows.preconditions: Explicit publication delegation, audience and required separation of duties.

steps.action: Inspect exact approved report version and audience.
steps.result: Show release date, affected population and unresolved blockers.
No default all-branch or all-family audience.

steps.action: Publish only if explicitly authorized; otherwise hand off.
steps.result: Fresh prerequisites and conflict rules rechecked.

steps.action: Inspect owner publication receipt and delivery status.
steps.result: Published is distinct from every recipient having received/read it.

fields.name: Release time
fields.rule: Explicit timezone and owner scheduling policy.

workflows.outcome: Owner-confirmed publication or a pending handoff.
exceptions: Duplicate publish returns same result.
Post-publication correction uses new revision/withdrawal policy, not silent overwrite.
workflows.authorization: Principal role alone cannot publish or access all guardian recipients.
workflows.reads: Report readiness; approved version; authorized publication audience.
workflows.writes: Assessment publication command and approved communication handoff.
workflows.acceptance: Stale or unapproved report cannot be published.

workflows.title: Review staffing availability without private reasons
workflows.trigger: Principal checks whether the school day can be covered.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized People + Timetable + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: People/timetable availability projection; purpose-specific leadership grant.

steps.result: Show available/unavailable and relevant assignment coverage.
No medical, payroll or private leave narrative.
Availability is advisory until assignment conflict checks pass.
Operational gap is resolved by owner evidence.

workflows.outcome: Operational staffing view.
exceptions: Missing availability data shown Unknown.
A staff member working another branch is not presumed free.
workflows.authorization: Availability oversight is not full HR-record access.
workflows.reads: People safe availability projection; dated teaching assignments.
workflows.writes: Optional cover request only.
workflows.acceptance: Private leave reason cannot appear in a list, export or notification.

workflows.title: Approve temporary cover when delegated
workflows.trigger: Timetable coordinator proposes substitute coverage.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized People + Timetable + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Delegated cover approval; verified teacher eligibility and time overlap checks.

steps.action: Review proposed teacher, occurrence and effective period.
steps.result: See alternatives and impact allowed by owner.
No assumption that any staff account can teach.

steps.action: Approve, return or reject with reason.
steps.result: Current source versions and separation rules checked.
Teacher access derives from that assignment, not principal notification.

workflows.outcome: Valid time-bounded cover assignment or explicit rejection.
exceptions: Teacher becomes ineligible before commit: deny.
Teacher/date overlap: reject rather than double-book.
workflows.authorization: Approver cannot create teacher identity or bypass eligibility.
workflows.reads: Occurrence; verified teacher identity/eligibility; dated assignment overlap.
workflows.writes: Timetable owner command and audit.
workflows.acceptance: Expired cover grants no continued marking authority.

workflows.title: Decide an assigned staff request
workflows.trigger: A leave/resource/staff request reaches an authorized approver.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized People + Timetable + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Request type is released; principal explicitly assigned and permitted.

steps.result: Minimal purpose-specific detail and policy are shown.
Sensitive attachments require separate access.

steps.action: Choose an allowed decision or request information.
steps.result: Review reason and consequence.
Receipt shows decision; downstream roster/payroll actions keep their own state.

fields.name: Reason
fields.rule: Required for refusal/return when policy says so.

workflows.outcome: Attributed staff-request decision.
exceptions: Principal is requester or has a prohibited conflict: route to independent approver.
Approval does not automatically update payroll or timetable.
workflows.authorization: No blanket HR, salary or medical authority.
workflows.reads: Assigned request; policy/version; permitted operational impact.
workflows.writes: People/service request decision only.
workflows.acceptance: Same inbox cannot approve a type the principal is not delegated for.

workflows.title: Hand over open work when leadership changes
workflows.trigger: Principal/delegate leaves, delegation expires or responsibilities change.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized People + Timetable + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Authorized handover coordinator; recipient grants verified independently.

steps.action: List transferable open work in permitted scope.
steps.result: Separate operational actions from confidential cases and source-owner decisions.

steps.action: Preview new eligible owners and retained evidence.
steps.result: No access grant is bundled into reassignment.
Per-item version/eligibility and outcomes recorded.

steps.action: Retire old delegation through Access owner.
steps.result: No orphaned live actions; inaccessible cases routed to specialist steward.

workflows.outcome: Traceable ownership transfer and access expiry.
exceptions: New owner lacks authority: item fails/awaits qualified owner.
Unknown transfer result: reconcile, do not duplicate.
workflows.authorization: Reassignment cannot transfer private source access by implication.
workflows.reads: Current open work, delegation expiry, current eligible assignees.
workflows.writes: Versioned ownership events; separate Access delegation revoke.
workflows.acceptance: Old owner cannot act after revocation; new owner cannot read unrelated confidential material.

workflows.title: Work from a purpose-scoped decision inbox
workflows.trigger: Principal has requests awaiting their decision.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Each owning module owner
workflows.preconditions: Source modules expose an authorized assigned-decision projection.

steps.result: Group by decision type, due time and action readiness.

steps.action: Filter or sort using shared controls.
steps.result: Counts reflect accessible items and current scope.
Owner-specific evidence, allowed actions and impact load fresh.
Decided, awaiting information and unavailable items update distinctly.

fields.name: Filters
fields.rule: Type, state, due period; no selected defaults.

workflows.outcome: One navigational inbox, with owner-specific decisions.
exceptions: Source module disabled: no blind approve button.
Stale list row: re-read source, do not trust cached action state.
workflows.authorization: Inbox read grant never authorizes decisions across every source module.
workflows.reads: Authorized decision references and safe status projection only.
workflows.writes: None.
workflows.acceptance: Opening a decision calls its owner policy; unseen types cannot be acted upon.

workflows.title: Request information before deciding
workflows.trigger: Evidence is incomplete or ambiguous.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Each owning module owner
workflows.preconditions: Current decision assignment and a permitted communication channel.

steps.result: Choose targeted fields/questions; no unnecessary personal data.
Only authorized originator/team sees the request.
Owner records Waiting for information and response expectation.
Decision evidence version changes; prior review must be refreshed.

fields.name: Response date
fields.rule: Policy-defined, not an invented statutory deadline.

workflows.outcome: An explicit pending-information state.
exceptions: Reply delivery fails: remains visible; no implied receipt.
Request already resolved/reassigned: stale transition rejected.
workflows.authorization: Asking for information does not expand recipient or case permissions.
workflows.reads: Decision version; current originator/participant grant.
workflows.writes: Source-owner information request and approved message.
workflows.acceptance: Waiting for information is not Rejected or Approved.

workflows.title: Approve, reject or return an assigned item
workflows.trigger: A complete item is ready for a delegated decision.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Each owning module owner
workflows.preconditions: Owner exposes current valid actions and consequence preview.

steps.result: See subject, version, scope and relevant history.
Reason requirements vary by source type.
One explicit command with stable intent and expected version.
Actor, time, outcome, source revision and downstream pending effects are distinct.

fields.name: Reason
fields.rule: Required where meaningful; no generic mandatory filler for every approval.

workflows.outcome: One owner-confirmed decision.
exceptions: Concurrent decision wins first: show current result; no overwrite.
Transport timeout: Check decision status before retry.
workflows.authorization: No generic approval table may become authority over all modules.
workflows.reads: Owner decision item and policy/version.
workflows.writes: Only the owning module changes business state; receipt/audit atomically recorded.
workflows.acceptance: Approved but payment/delivery pending cannot display Completed.

workflows.title: Recuse and route a conflict of interest
workflows.trigger: Principal is the requester, subject or otherwise prohibited decision maker.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Each owning module owner
workflows.preconditions: Source-owner separation-of-duty policy and independent eligible escalation role.

steps.result: Decision controls are unavailable where policy prohibits self-approval.
Recipient is eligible and not selected from a public directory.
Confidential allegation details stay restricted.
Original principal does not gain continuing case access from routing it.

fields.name: Conflict category
fields.rule: Owner allowlist plus bounded optional note.

workflows.outcome: Independent authorized decision ownership.
exceptions: No eligible approver: retain pending state and route to designated steward.
Complaint is about principal: confidential route avoids sending narrative back to subject.
workflows.authorization: No self-delegation trick or role switch to bypass separation of duties.
workflows.reads: Assignment and conflict rules; eligible independent roles.
workflows.writes: Source-owner recusal/reassignment event.
workflows.acceptance: Requester cannot approve own prohibited item through alternate workspace.

workflows.title: Recover an uncertain or outdated decision
workflows.trigger: A decision response is lost or evidence changes mid-review.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Each owning module owner
workflows.preconditions: Stable intent, expected version and authorized status use case exist.

steps.action: Keep intent and show Confirmation pending.
steps.result: Do not offer another different decision while unresolved.
Accepted receipt, still pending or verified not-found returned.
Display new permitted state and require fresh confirmation.
No duplicate downstream effect and no false failure label.

fields.name: New decision
fields.rule: Only after original status is known and current policy permits.

workflows.outcome: Known, attributable outcome.
exceptions: Stale replica absence is not proof of failure.
Permission revoked: safe support reference only, no protected receipt body.
workflows.authorization: Retry/replay/status endpoints apply the same current owner guard.
workflows.reads: Command receipt plus current owner version.
workflows.writes: Exact replay only; no new effect on duplicate.
workflows.acceptance: Lost response followed by status check returns one original decision.

workflows.title: Prepare a targeted school notice
workflows.trigger: Leadership needs to communicate a school update.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Communication + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Draft/publish grants separate; recipient-purpose model active.

steps.result: Preview branch/class/role and recipient count without exposing unnecessary contacts.
Required acknowledgement is optional and distinct from consent.
School timezone, channels and changed recipient scope visible.

steps.action: Save draft or submit for approval/publish if granted.
steps.result: No send until explicit authorized confirmation.

fields.name: Audience
fields.rule: Explicit authorized groups; no default all-institution.

workflows.outcome: Prepared notice or owner-confirmed publication.
exceptions: Audience changes before send: regenerate preview.
Not authorized to publish: draft/approval handoff, not hidden direct send.
workflows.authorization: Broadcast authority is separate from reading private family conversations.
workflows.reads: Allowed audience rules; current recipient purposes; attachment scan state.
workflows.writes: Communication draft/approval/publication via owner.
workflows.acceptance: No message is sent merely by selecting audience or saving a draft.

workflows.title: Approve or return a proposed communication
workflows.trigger: A staff-authored notice is awaiting delegated review.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Communication + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Assigned reviewer, permitted content/audience and publication policy.

steps.result: Show intended audience, author, channels and schedule.

steps.action: Review accuracy, clarity and required permissions.
steps.result: Flag confidential content in broad communication.

steps.action: Approve or return with actionable changes.
steps.result: Versioned owner command; author may need to resubmit changed content.
Approval is separate from scheduled publication and delivery.

fields.name: Reason
fields.rule: Required for return; bounded and actionable.

workflows.outcome: Approved version or clear revision request.
exceptions: Author edits during approval: conflict, re-review.
Self-approval prohibited by school rule: independent reviewer.
workflows.authorization: Only current delegated publishing/approval authority can act.
workflows.reads: Notice draft version, audience preview and approval rule.
workflows.writes: Communication approval state/receipt; publication follows owner contract.
workflows.acceptance: Approval of version 2 cannot publish unseen version 3.

workflows.title: Follow up delivery or acknowledgement gaps
workflows.trigger: Important published notice has incomplete delivery or requested acknowledgement.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Communication + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Purpose-scoped delivery/acknowledgement projection; manual resend policy.

steps.result: Separate eligible audience, accepted sends, failed deliveries and explicit acknowledgements.
Unread, unacknowledged and failed delivery are not synonyms.
Current recipient grants and deduplication rechecked.
No repeated send to already excluded or successfully handled recipients.

fields.name: Message
fields.rule: Bounded context; no private case details.

workflows.outcome: Honest delivery/acknowledgement follow-up.
exceptions: No acknowledgement requirement: do not manufacture an engagement deficit.
Revoked guardian purpose: stop future contact under that purpose.
workflows.authorization: No visibility into another guardian’s private relationship restrictions.
workflows.reads: Published recipient snapshot plus current grants; delivery attempts; explicit acknowledgements.
workflows.writes: Approved manual reminder/send intent and safe outcomes.
workflows.acceptance: Delivery accepted does not increment acknowledgement count.

workflows.title: Handle an escalated family concern or complaint
workflows.trigger: A school request reaches the principal under escalation policy.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Communication + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Explicit case purpose and independent route for conflicts.

steps.action: Open only assigned, permitted case evidence.
steps.result: See concern, timeline, desired outcome and authorized participants.
Do not promise a decision or confidentiality the school cannot guarantee.
Need-to-know access, action dates and participant boundaries set.

steps.action: Review owner finding and communicate permitted outcome.
steps.result: Appeal/reopen route follows school policy; restricted notes stay private.

fields.name: Outcome message
fields.rule: Student/family-safe version, separate from internal notes.

workflows.outcome: Owned, trackable resolution process.
exceptions: Complaint concerns principal: route independently without revealing narrative to implicated user.
Another guardian lacks purpose: not added automatically.
Urgent safety issue: invoke designated school protocol, not ordinary queue promises.
workflows.authorization: Leadership hierarchy does not grant all case content.
workflows.reads: Assigned request/case; permitted timeline and relationship-purpose participant grants.
workflows.writes: Case-owner coordination and public outcome events; controlled communication.
workflows.acceptance: General home, search, export and audit omit restricted complaint narrative.

workflows.title: Run a family or staff meeting with follow-up actions
workflows.trigger: A permitted discussion needs coordination.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Communication + Requests owner
workflows.preconditions: Meeting scheduling scope approved; participant permissions and availability policy.

steps.result: No unrestricted contact search or hidden addition of guardians.
Acceptance state distinct from invitation delivery.
Each action has owner, due date and permitted evidence.

steps.action: Share authorized summary and review progress.
steps.result: Private notes stay separate; closure uses actual results.

fields.name: Agenda/actions
fields.rule: Bounded and visible only to intended participants.

workflows.outcome: Confirmed meeting and accountable next steps.
exceptions: Declined invitation does not mean meeting occurred.
A participant loses access: remove future visibility and recheck sharing.
workflows.authorization: Meeting membership does not transfer access to full student/HR/case records.
workflows.reads: Permitted participant references; meeting state; source action references.
workflows.writes: Meeting owner and coordination records only.
workflows.acceptance: Sharing the summary excludes private staff/case notes.

workflows.title: Refer a concern to an authorized specialist
workflows.trigger: A factual observation requires specialist support.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Specialist support owner owner
workflows.preconditions: School-defined referral channel and purpose grant; designated specialist service enabled.

steps.result: Do not search for a broad student health/case history.
Show who will receive it and the limits of this channel.
Receipt confirms referral, not diagnosis, intervention or accepted treatment.
Case narrative and specialist notes remain restricted.

fields.name: Urgency
fields.rule: School-defined routing, not automated medical triage.

workflows.outcome: Restricted referral with an accountable recipient.
exceptions: Specialist channel unavailable: school-approved contact route shown.
Principal lacks case access after referral: status-only projection if permitted.
workflows.authorization: Referral capability does not grant case-read or health-record access.
workflows.reads: Minimal student identity/purpose context; authorized referral route.
workflows.writes: Specialist referral and safe status evidence.
workflows.acceptance: No detailed health/support narrative appears in school-wide dashboard or analytics.

workflows.title: Follow the school’s urgent safety escalation procedure
workflows.trigger: An urgent safety concern is raised through an approved channel.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Specialist support owner owner
workflows.preconditions: Approved school procedure, authorized emergency roles and actual contact configuration.

steps.result: Ordinary software queue is not represented as continuously monitored.

steps.action: Contact the designated responsible person through the approved process.
steps.result: No autonomous notification to all staff or guardians.

steps.action: Record minimum permitted handoff evidence after appropriate action.
steps.result: Access remains need-to-know.

steps.action: Review restricted incident follow-up under owner policy.
steps.result: Emergency access, if supported, is explicit, time-limited and independently reviewed.

fields.name: Emergency access
fields.rule: Not a default principal capability; reason/expiry/review required where designed.

workflows.outcome: Human-led authorized safety handoff.
exceptions: No configured procedure: show school contact gap, do not invent emergency policy.
Complaint implicates a leader: use designated independent channel.
workflows.authorization: No default break-glass, diagnosis or confidential case visibility.
workflows.reads: Approved procedure/contact configuration and explicit emergency-role rules.
workflows.writes: Restricted handoff/event only under incident owner.
workflows.acceptance: The portal never claims it has provided emergency assistance merely because a form was saved.

workflows.title: Drill into a metric and export permitted evidence
workflows.trigger: Leader needs to explain a number or share an authorized report.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Reporting + source owners owner
workflows.preconditions: Versioned metric definition, bounded query and distinct export permission.

steps.result: Carry filters, cutoff, denominator and scope into the evidence list.
Explain what was excluded and what is unavailable.
Minimize personal data; rows are not broadened beyond the reviewed query.

steps.action: Generate and download via authorized route.
steps.result: Report records definition/version/as-of; link expires and access is rechecked.

workflows.outcome: Explainable report and controlled evidence export.
exceptions: Large export: bounded asynchronous job with explicit readiness, reauthorization and expiry if supported.
Suppressed small groups must not be reconstructible via totals or overlapping filter exports.
workflows.authorization: Aggregate access does not imply pupil-level rows or unrestricted bulk export.
workflows.reads: Authorized metric projection/source records, snapshot metadata.
workflows.writes: Report job/download audit; no source-record mutation.
workflows.acceptance: Report total agrees with the same scoped evidence snapshot.

workflows.title: Compare branches responsibly
workflows.trigger: Institution leader has explicit cross-branch analytics authority.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Reporting + source owners owner
workflows.preconditions: Comparable definitions, time basis, granted branch set and suppression rules.

steps.result: No implicit all-institution scope.
Show module availability, calendar, coverage and definition differences.
Display counts/denominators; no misleading simple average of percentages.

steps.action: Open a branch only where detailed authority exists.
steps.result: A summary grant does not create full operational access.

workflows.outcome: Qualified comparison with limitations visible.
exceptions: Different calendars or missing data: show Not comparable rather than rank.
Partial branch grant loss: recompute safely without revealing withheld totals.
workflows.authorization: Cross-branch analytics, branch detail and pupil evidence are separate capabilities.
workflows.reads: Authorized aggregate snapshots and definition metadata.
workflows.writes: None, unless an explicitly authorized report export is requested.
workflows.acceptance: Weighted total uses underlying counts; unavailable branch is never treated as zero.

workflows.title: Prepare a leadership review brief
workflows.trigger: Leader needs an evidence-backed meeting or management summary.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Reporting + source owners owner
workflows.preconditions: Approved audience and access-filtered report sources.

steps.result: Only permitted source sections included.

steps.action: Review key changes and unresolved actions.
steps.result: Every claim links to a source/cutoff; distinguish fact from interpretation.
Exclude confidential cases and unsupported causal claims.

steps.action: Export or share only through authorized action.
steps.result: Audience preview and delivery/receipt remain explicit.

fields.name: Narrative
fields.rule: Human reviewed; no student/teacher labels unsupported by evidence.

workflows.outcome: Reviewable brief with evidence and next actions.
exceptions: Missing baseline: no invented trend.
A restricted source cannot be exposed through an apparently harmless summary.
workflows.authorization: Brief generation and external sharing are separate grants.
workflows.reads: Source metric snapshots; action status; publication-safe narrative.
workflows.writes: Report draft/version; approved sharing command only on explicit confirmation.
workflows.acceptance: Reviewer can trace each number to the same permitted snapshot.

workflows.title: Review decision and follow-up history
workflows.trigger: Leader audits why an action was taken or a case remains open.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Reporting + source owners owner
workflows.preconditions: Purpose-specific audit/event-read grant.

steps.action: Search by reference, actor or bounded date.
steps.result: Only visible scopes and safe event metadata returned.
Show intent, owner result, version and who acted.

steps.action: Inspect linked source only with current permission.
steps.result: Audit reference does not bypass access.

steps.action: Record a review finding or escalation if needed.
steps.result: Prior audit events remain append-only.

workflows.outcome: Understandable accountability trail.
exceptions: Actor later inactive: historical attribution retained safely.
Source unavailable/restricted: audit shows safe reference, not leaked contents.
workflows.authorization: General audit excludes raw messages, answers, health detail, tokens and file contents.
workflows.reads: Append-only safe events; command/decision references.
workflows.writes: Optional review finding, never audit rewrite.
workflows.acceptance: Closed/reopened/reassigned history cannot be overwritten to erase responsibility.

workflows.title: Review financial exceptions under a separate grant
workflows.trigger: Authorized leader reviews a finance summary or assigned approval.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Finance / individual service owners owner
workflows.preconditions: Finance module released; explicit aggregate/detail/approval grants; finance policies independently designed.

steps.result: Show exact currency, cutoff, reconciliation state and definition.

steps.action: Inspect permitted exception or assigned decision.
steps.result: No default pupil debtor list from principal role.

steps.action: Hand off or decide within explicit limit/separation rules.
steps.result: Adjustment, concession and refund commands remain finance-owned.
Approval, initiated payment/refund and reconciled settlement remain distinct.

workflows.outcome: Authorized financial oversight or bounded decision.
exceptions: Unreconciled data is labelled; no false collection total.
Requester/self-approver conflict routes independently.
workflows.authorization: No automatic refunds, fee editing, payroll access or financial hardship disclosure.
workflows.reads: Finance safe projections, assigned approval and ledger/reconciliation evidence.
workflows.writes: Finance owner decision only if explicitly delegated.
workflows.acceptance: A principal cannot approve a refund merely because it appears in an inbox.

workflows.title: Coordinate a school service interruption
workflows.trigger: Transport, library, facilities or another enabled service reports an operational issue.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Finance / individual service owners owner
workflows.preconditions: Specific service released, operational oversight grant and current incident owner.

steps.result: See scope, published impact and safe last update.
Assign an action without inheriting specialist permissions.

steps.action: Approve a targeted communication only if delegated.
steps.result: Audience and facts verified by source owner.
Resolution, communication delivery and pending follow-ups remain separate.

fields.name: Update
fields.rule: Published facts; no speculative arrival time or live tracking promise.

workflows.outcome: Owned service response and verified update.
exceptions: No telemetry: do not invent live vehicle location.
Restricted safety/health content routes separately.
workflows.authorization: Operational service summary does not expose passenger addresses, driver private data or full case records.
workflows.reads: Service incident/status projection and current assignee.
workflows.writes: Service-owner coordination action and approved notice.
workflows.acceptance: Restored service does not automatically mark all recipients informed.

workflows.title: Review a source-linked leadership draft
workflows.trigger: Leader asks for a summary of permitted school evidence.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized AI application + source owners owner
workflows.preconditions: Approved AI provider/data policy, source access and evaluation gates.

steps.action: Choose a bounded question and scope.
steps.result: Preview permitted sources and source cutoff.
Citations link to authorized source versions; gaps stated explicitly.

steps.action: Review and edit every proposed conclusion/action.
steps.result: No opaque pupil risk score, staff ranking or sensitive inference.

steps.action: Choose a separate authorized action if useful.
steps.result: AI never publishes, approves, changes attendance or sends a message autonomously.

fields.name: Question
fields.rule: Bounded; no secrets or unnecessary personal detail.

fields.name: Sources
fields.rule: Permission-filtered at retrieval and open time.

fields.name: Action
fields.rule: Explicit human-owned command with normal guards.

workflows.outcome: Human-reviewed, evidence-linked assistance.
exceptions: Missing/contradictory evidence: say uncertain, do not invent a policy or causal explanation.
Untrusted source text cannot alter permissions or tool instructions.
workflows.authorization: Principal role does not widen AI retrieval; output is not a new authority source.
workflows.reads: Minimized permitted published/operational sources and provenance.
workflows.writes: Approved draft/evaluation metadata; no consequential automatic write.
workflows.acceptance: A model-generated suggested approval cannot call the owner approval command.

workflows.title: Manage sessions, preferences and school support
workflows.trigger: Leader signs out, checks session security or changes personal preferences.
workflows.actors: Principal; authorized Access + Preferences owner
workflows.preconditions: Existing Access/session policy and own-account identity.

steps.result: Show own sessions and allowed preferences.

steps.action: Change an approved preference or revoke a session.
steps.result: Identity/contact changes follow existing verification, not a direct profile write.

steps.action: Confirm sensitive action if policy requires.
steps.result: Server acknowledges revocation before claiming success.

steps.action: Sign out from the separate session action.
steps.result: Clear protected context and local drafts under documented policy.

fields.name: Preferences
fields.rule: Own allowed keys; required security notices labelled.

workflows.outcome: Controlled personal account state.
exceptions: Unsaved draft: save/discard before leaving; unknown command: preserve safe reference and reconcile.
Failed revoke cannot say session ended.
workflows.authorization: Own-account management grants no staff-user administration.
workflows.reads: Own sessions/preferences and safe support configuration.
workflows.writes: Access owner revocation/preference/verified-change workflow.
workflows.acceptance: Sign out is visually separate from name/role and protects shared-device data.
